Welcome to the
Paperless Civil Service Portal
GOVTEST

Fast. Transparent. Easy to Use

Our Ministry has transitioned to a fully paperless process, making it easier for you to access services, submit requests, and track progress anytime, anywhere, without visiting our offices.

Steps To Engage Us
1

Choose a service from the menu

2

Fill out the form and attach required documents

3

Submit online - no queues, no paper

4

Receive a reference number for tracking

5

Get notified when your request is processed

What You Can Do Here
Engage Us
Through this portal, you can reach us to request a service, make enquiries, submit complaint, make suggestions or simply commend us. We will ensure your engagement gets the attention it deserves.
